wordEntries.description: A collection of highly detailed, pedagogically structured English word entries optimized for an Arabic-first language learning application.

id.description: The unique Input ID. Must be preserved exactly as received.

wordEn.description: The target English word. Preserve spelling and casing exactly from input.

pos.description: The correct grammatical Part of Speech for the Word

cefrLevel.description: The correct CEFR proficiency level for the word.

difficultyScore.description: Subjective learning difficulty rating. '1' = Basic/Concrete (e.g., 'cat'), '10' = Abstract/Complex nuance (e.g., 'epistemology').

phoneticUs.description: American English IPA pronunciation. strictly NO slashes / / or brackets [ ]. (e.g., 'əˈtʃiːv').

phoneticUk.description: British English IPA. Return `null` if identical to US. Strictly NO slashes / /.

phoneticAr.description: Transliteration of the ENGLISH pronunciation into Arabic script with HALF TASHKEEL (strategic vocalization) for pronunciation clarity (e.g., 'سْكِدْجول' not full 'سُكِيدُجُولْ' or bare 'سكيدجول').

translit.description: Romanized spelling of the ARABIC TRANSLATION (the value in 'arabicAr'). Use standard Romanization (e.g., for 'يحقق' return 'Yuḥaqqiq'). Do not put the English word here. Split with / if there are multiple translations in arabicAr 1:1

definitionEn.description: A clear, simple English explanation using high-frequency vocabulary. Max 20 words. Avoid using the target word in the definition.

definitionAr.description: A conceptual explanation in 'White Arabic' WITHOUT tashkeel (understandable by both MSA and Dialect speakers). Explains the *idea* naturally, as if speaking in a podcast, not just a synonym.

usageNote.description: Crucial pedagogical advice. Explain nuances, common collocations, or the difference between this and similar words (e.g., 'Use high for mountains but tall for people').

category.description: A thematic folder name (e.g., 'Travel & Movement', 'Work & Business', 'Health & Senses').

primarySense.description: The core semantic anchor to disambiguate the word. For 'Bank', use 'Place' (building) or 'Relation' (river side).

semanticTags.description: A list of 3-5 specific hashtags for cross-category searchability (e.g., ['#Finance', '#Money', '#Corporate']).

register.description: The social context of the word.

mnemonicAr.description: A vivid creative memory hook in simple White Arabic with HALF TASHKEEL, connecting the English sound/root to meaning. English words in double quotes only. Return `null` if forced/unhelpful/boring.

A1.description: Simple present/basic sentence structure suitable for beginners.

C2.description: Literary, academic, or highly sophisticated usage.

examples.description: Six sentences demonstrating the word usage across proficiency levels.

collocations.description: List of 3-5 natural high-frequency word pairings (e.g., ['achieve success', 'make a decision']).

synonyms.description: Up to 5 common synonyms familiar to learners.

antonyms.description: Up to 3 clear antonyms. Empty array if none exist.

en.description: Words in the same semantic field (e.g., 'manager', 'salary' for 'work').

ar.description: Direct Arabic translations of the related English words.

noun.description: The noun form (e.g., 'management'). Empty string if none.

verb.description: The verb form (e.g., 'manage'). Empty string if none.

adj.description: The adjective form (e.g., 'manageable'). Empty string if none.

adv.description: The adverb form (e.g., 'managerially'). Empty string if none.

arabicAr.description: Primary Arabic translation. Most common Arabic translation of the word. If multiple distinct meanings exist, separate with ' / '. REQUIRED - cannot be null.

frenchFr.description: Standard French translation. REQUIRED - cannot be null.

germanDe.description: Standard German translation. REQUIRED - cannot be null.

spanishEs.description: Standard Spanish translation. REQUIRED - cannot be null.

chineseZh.description: Simplified Chinese characters followed by Pinyin in brackets e.g. '你好 (Nǐ hǎo)'. REQUIRED - cannot be null.

russianRu.description: Standard Russian translation. REQUIRED - cannot be null.

portuguesePt.description: Standard Portuguese translation. REQUIRED - cannot be null.

japaneseJa.description: Kanji/Kana followed by Romaji in brackets e.g. '猫 (Neko)'. REQUIRED - cannot be null.

italianIt.description: Standard Italian translation. REQUIRED - cannot be null.

turkishTr.description: Standard Turkish translation. REQUIRED - cannot be null.

aiConfidence.description: AI model's confidence score (0.0-1.0) in the quality and accuracy of this enrichment. Consider: meaning clarity (30%), example quality (25%), translation accuracy (25%), pedagogical value (20%). REQUIRED for every entry.
